title: Amplicon sequence of pathogenic genes in environmental sample
description: We aimed to develop a method to simultaneously detect various pathogens by sequencing multiplex PCR amplicons, compare the results with those obtained by digital PCR, and apply the method to detect pathogens in river water and sewage samples. This data is the sequence of the pathogenic gene in river water and sewage samples amplified by multiplex PCR.
center: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, University of Miyazaki
samples: Amplicon sequence of pathogenic gene (aggR, stx1, stx2, ipaH, eae, STh, LT)
